Provenance: Supplied terminal day-140 diagnostic; read-only, no commands executed.
Units: Integer physical and monetary subunits, 10000 per good/coin. Prices are ratios per whole good.

Goals.Title: Regional Survey
Goals.Explanation: Visit the recovery, processing and forest towns with owned ships.

Goals.Title: Artisan Guild
Goals.Explanation: Operate a Sawmill and Furniture Workshop, and privately produce two Furniture.

Goals.Title: Bread for the Coast
Goals.Explanation: Supply four net Bread to Westhaven. Local purchases subtract credit.

Goals.Title: Prosperous Enterprise
Goals.Explanation: Simultaneously grow reference Company Value by 100 coins and retain 100 liquid coins.

Accounts.Note: Company accounts include NPCs once. Ship cash is a compatibility projection and is deliberately excluded from account totals.
